lines: [furious] FINE! Five hundred dollars! TAKE IT!
[smug] [whispering] Psst. Exclusive investment club. Double your money in one week.
[fake pity] Oh, wait... it's not for piggy banks.
[sly] It's for SERIOUS investors. You could never afford the entry fee.
[casual] Five hundred. In gift cards. Today only.
[furious] I have five hundred dollars! I'll show you!
[huffy] He said I can't afford it!
[calm] That's the trick. He insulted you so you'd want to prove him wrong.
[nervous] Uh... the club closes in ten seconds!
[deadpan] Guaranteed money. Gift cards. A countdown. Three red flags.
[gasps] Wait... he insulted me... to SELL me?!
[warmly] Exactly. Real investments never rush you, and never ask for gift cards.
[panicked] Okay, okay! VIP discount! Four ninety-nine!
